enemies.name: Hardy Hornbeast
enemies.flavour_text: A variety of hornbeast which startles into a frenzy at the drop of a hat. They attack viciously, throwing their sharp horns against anything nearby without the slightest warning. Given how often they concuss themselves, scholars are extremely confused as to how they haven't gone extinct yet.

abilities.text: Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding hornbeasts become Combat-Ready

enemies.name: Keenfanged Oxmane
enemies.flavour_text: An Oxmane subspecies particular to certain regions. Perennial contention with large prey has led their teeth to grow sharp, sinking fast and firm into the fleshy parts of their quarry. Undeterred by their companions dying to their prey's retaliation, they will launch attacks again and again.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking <Hornbeasts> and <Hardy Hornbeasts>

enemies.name: Daimoserrant Fowlbeast
enemies.flavour_text: A Serrant Fowlbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Stronger pectoral muscles increase its flight capabilities, rendering it capable of launching torrential offensives from high elevation. It makes a renewed territorial bid, this time on the entire sky.

abilities.text: Occasionally flings dead <Oxmanes>, dealing heavy Physical damage

enemies.name: Haribeast
enemies.flavour_text: A dangerous creature with a back covered in thorns. Every thorn has a developed and impressively elastic muscular connection; upon sensing danger, they can fire their thorns with an abrupt and startling power. Even so, some people still aspire to raise them as pets.

abilities.text: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is decreased
Deals damage in a semicircle to the rear at every fixed portion of health lost

enemies.name: Deathveil Assassin
enemies.flavour_text: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.

abilities.text: Invisible; the next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage.
Has Arts and Physical dodge.
Temporarily loses Invisibility, Physical dodge, and Arts dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.
Can pass through a blocking unit once when HP drops to below 50%.

enemies.name: Tribal Shaman
enemies.flavour_text: An apprentice caster who has learned some of the ancient Arts of their tribe. Although not yet proficient with Arts, it is enough to fight whoever they disagree with.

abilities.text: Attacks cause the target to receive a certain amount of this unit's ATK as Arts damage per second over a few seconds (stacks)

enemies.name: 'Anything Can Be Broken'
enemies.flavour_text: A contraption that hurls fruit with rock-hard shells instead of boulders, destroying all constructs in its detection range by targeting their weak points. The designer must surely have been an expert in architecture.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking constructs; when attacking constructs, gains greatly increased ATK

enemies.name: Leporibeast Shorthorn
enemies.flavour_text: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has small but sharp horns and is not aggressive, but will run and jump to avoid attacks when frightened. The meat is very tender.

abilities.text: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

enemies.name: Leporibeast Longhorn
enemies.flavour_text: A herbivorous beast commonly found almost anywhere in the wild. It has grown large horns, but will still run away on reflex, jumping even higher and faster. The meat is very tender.

abilities.text: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time

enemies.name: Mossback Beast
enemies.flavour_text: A beast with moss growing on its back, appearing round and gentle but it is actually fierce with a terrible temper. The moss on its body has a hemostatic effect, and it will eat it when injured.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

enemies.name: Lush Mossback Beast
enemies.flavour_text: A beast with moss all over its body, easily agitated compared to others of its kind because of tiny, hard-to-remove bugs hiding in its vegetation. The moss grows back extremely quickly, and it will sometimes eat some even when uninjured.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Gradually restores HP over time

enemies.name: Cragpincer
enemies.flavour_text: A crab-like creature with rocks on its shell that it uses to camouflage itself. Extremely tenacious, it can sometimes be found far from sources of water. A distant relative of Metal Crabs, but its meat is delicious.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

enemies.name: Crystalline Cragpincer
enemies.flavour_text: A Cragpincer with crystals on its shell, not only eye-catching but also extremely beautiful. However, it is also harder to handle. The completely crystallized carapace is a popular ornament once properly processed. It is said that some people also keep these as ornamental pets.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

enemies.name: Basic Harvester
enemies.flavour_text: Basic mechanical workers capable of gathering and transporting resources. Their capacity is not very large but they are industrious and diligent.

abilities.text: Automatically locates and attacks Ore Veins, returning spoils to the Harvester Hub

enemies.name: 'The Immortal'
enemies.flavour_text: A warrior of unknown background who wears exquisite but tattered armor. He strides forward, sand cupped within his hands, no longer responsive to anyone.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Recovers a percentage of its own HP when an allied unit is retreated or defeated within range

enemies.name: Great Wingbeast
enemies.flavour_text: An extremely silent Great Wingbeast. This Infected creature has a pair of crystallized wings bigger than its body, but cannot fly too high or for too long. A ferocious carnivore, but this one seems to have had its meal, and is merely curious about the tiny things that have appeared before it.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked.
Can turn into an aerial unit for a period of time
When flying, deals ranged splash Arts damage, also inflicting Burn

enemies.name: Sargonian Contract Assassin
enemies.flavour_text: A Sargonian assassin available for hire. Extremely agile with their unusual footwork. If the pay is generous enough, they are also willing to take on non-assassination work at their own discretion, and charge by the hour.

abilities.text: Invisible, blinks forward a short distance when blocked

enemies.name: Barrenlands Musbeast
enemies.flavour_text: A musbeast commonly found in the barrens. Though not particularly aggressive by nature, they become a bottomless pit of ruined foodstuffs when in groups.

abilities.text: When other Barrenlands Musbeasts are nearby, ATK increases (stacks)

enemies.name: Mine Drudge
enemies.flavour_text: A familiar sight in mine shafts for millennia. Laborers have always propped up the pinnacles of civilization with their rugged hands, but found their own feet mired in the mud of the label 'uncivilized.'

abilities.text: Deals more damage when attacking resources

enemies.name: Volatile Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: The name of this Originium Slug may actually be a misnomer, as the volatile part is actually the 'harvest' between its legs. When asked about this, its namers claimed that these creatures were too fast to be closely observed.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked by Operators or Summons; explodes when Blocked and deals great AoE damage

enemies.name: Wilderness Rogue
enemies.flavour_text: There will always be thieves out in the barrens, and they come in all shapes and sizes. These are no different, just that they carry treasure chests and run really fast.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemies.name: Spined Shellbeast
enemies.flavour_text: A type of hard and prickly shellbeast. If it retracts its head into its shell, just save your energy.

abilities.text: Retreats into its shell upon taking damage, reducing any further physical and Arts damage to 0. In this state, upon receiving damage from allied Operators, deals physical damage equal to 100% of their own ATK to the attacker. Will come out from its shell after taking no damage for a period of time

enemies.name: Luminous Fowlbeast
enemies.flavour_text: A small creature that can only be seen far from nomadic cities. With a flutter of its wings, it escapes once more into the shadows.

abilities.text: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time

enemies.name: Zümrütrüyası Priestess
enemies.flavour_text: A priestess whose allure reflects her power. The more eye-catching her flowers, the sharper her blade.

abilities.text: As her HP being reduced, her damage taken from units not blocked by herself is also gradually reduced to 0
Gains increased ATK when making consecutive attacks. (Resets when affected by Freeze, Stun, or Levitate)

enemies.name: Zümrütrüyası Acolyte
enemies.flavour_text: An acolyte whose charm reflects her power. The more delicate her flowers, the swifter her blade.

abilities.text: When unblocked, damage taken is reduced by 50%

enemies.name: Wandering Troubadour
enemies.flavour_text: No matter where they go, the troubadours who cross the barrens to entertain others will always be surrounded by graceful, flickering flames and deafening cheers.

abilities.text: Deals heavy Burn to nearby units every second, and recovers a huge amount of HP every second
Become Silenced during the Wet Season or when Frozen

enemies.name: Wandering Apprentice
enemies.flavour_text: The young apprentices who follow behind the Wandering Troubadours are not yet proficient at controlling flames, but can already perform the critical job of moving the oil cannisters.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Burn, and recovers HP every second
Become Silenced during the Wet Season or when Frozen

enemies.name: Timestream Guardian
enemies.flavour_text: Nobody knows when this colossus was created. It responds to time with silence, its fists acting as their persevering faith.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
After 2 attacks, the next attack deals heavy Physical damage to targets within range and inflicts Stun
When HP falls below 50%, gains significantly increased ASPD

enemies.name: Crystalline Titanibeast
enemies.flavour_text: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It endeavored and molted into the sturdiest of shells, yet still cannot escape its enemy's ruthless pursuit. Forever at odds with Crystalline Oberobeasts.

abilities.text: Periodically gains a Shield that blocks damage; the Shield lasts for 80 attacks before breaking
When below 50% HP, attacks all units within Attack Range at the same time

enemies.name: Crystalline Oberobeast
enemies.flavour_text: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It resembles a metal crab with sharper pincers, allowing it to easily tear its prey apart. Forever foes with Crystalline Titanibeasts.

abilities.text: Attacks strike twice; when below 50% HP, attacks strike 4 times instead
Reduces the target's DEF with each attack
Upon approaching a Crystalline Titanibeast, instantly slays it and obtains some of its abilities; afterwards, each attack now strikes 4 times

enemies.name: Sailraider
enemies.flavour_text: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. They always appear in unexpected places, ripping opposing frontlines apart as they roam the land.

abilities.text: Low-Altitude Hovering; has increased Attack Range while in Low-Altitude Hovering
Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Crashes upon losing a certain percentage of HP, dealing heavy damage in an area and Stunning itself
After a period of time, reenters Low-Altitude Hovering status

enemies.name: Dustweaver
enemies.flavour_text: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. Sand pervades sky, dust obstructs sun. Life collapses, evil flourishes.

abilities.text: [Sandstorm's Dustwake] Increases the Movement Speed and ASPD of enemies within a certain range (including self)
Devours the blocker when blocked (up to a maximum of 3), and increases the effect of [Sandstorm's Dustwake]

enemies.name: Annihilator
enemies.flavour_text: Time and time again it grows weaker, and yet it gets back up every time. This is the Annihilator—this is Sargon.

abilities.text: First Form
[Annihilation] Causes the next attack to Stun the target, and makes itself unblockable by allied Operators and Summons; deals a large amount of Arts damage when passing through allied units
Second Form
Increases ATK and ASPD

enemies.name: Diligent Laborer
enemies.flavour_text: Laborers such as these can be seen everywhere across the barrens. Their diligence is their greatest virtue.

abilities.text: Moves at regular speed only when in visible range

enemies.name: Flying Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: Wild and infected, it can glide a short distance on the wind with its small wings, enough to fly over obstacles and evade capture.

abilities.text: Low-Altitude Hovering

enemies.name: Charging Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: Wild and infected, it can move extremely quickly to survive in the harsh environment of the barrens, using its acceleration to either charge its foes with its horn or escape out of reach.

abilities.text: Gradually accelerates when moving. Its first attack at max speed stuns targets blocking it.

enemies.name: Armored Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: Wild and infected, it is much more resistant to physical harm than regular Originium Slugs in order to survive in the harsh environment of the barrens. The sharp corners on its shell make it difficult for predators to attack.

abilities.text: Physical and Arts damage taken from blocking units are greatly reduced.

enemies.name: 'Liquid Shifter'
enemies.flavour_text: Curious little creatures that roam the wilderness, able to emulate images in mirages. The latest research indicates that this is not a true transformation, but merely an optical illusion.

abilities.text: Appears disguised as another enemy. Does not attack when disguised.
Reveals true form upon taking damage.
Chance to drop <Standard-Issue Item> when defeated.
Periodically creates <Fresh Water> when held in <Large Corral>.

enemies.name: Rogue Burdenbeast
enemies.flavour_text: Burdenbeasts that once served the lord ameers have escaped into the wilderness, still carrying their loads. Their time in captivity has made them more agile than normal burdenbeasts, and better at fighting those who would take them captive again.

abilities.text: Starts immune to Physical and Arts damage below a certain amount.
When taking more than a certain amount of damage in a single instance, falls down and randomly drops a large amount of Minor Ingredients (triggers only once), losing its damage reduction effect.
Periodically drops <Crude Gold> when held in <Large Corral>.

enemies.name: Thalebeast
enemies.flavour_text: A mossback beast covered in thale, a plant native to Arsalan that is highly sensitive to environmental changes. This allows the Thalebeast to predict shifts in the weather.

abilities.text: Exotic Beast
During <Thunderstorm> and <Thunderburst>, always draws thunder strikes to the tiles it passes through while itself is immune to thunder strike damage.
During <Scorching Sun> and <Bright Sun>, attacks inflict a certain percentage of ATK as Burn. Allied units within a certain range also take extra damage when Burn bursts.
Gains Invisibility and increased attack range in <Sandstorm> and <Great Sandstorm>.

enemies.name: Thalebeast
enemies.flavour_text: A mossback beast covered in thale, a plant native to Arsalan that is highly sensitive to environmental changes. This allows the Thalebeast to predict shifts in the weather.

abilities.text: Helps your side when on the field; unblockable.
During <Thunderstorm> and <Thunderburst>, always draws thunder strikes to the tiles it passes through while itself is immune to thunder strike damage.
During <Scorching Sun> and <Bright Sun>, attacks inflict a certain percentage of Burn. Nearby enemy units also gain a certain percentage of Elemental Fragility.
Gains Invisibility and increased attack range in <Sandstorm> and <Great Sandstorm>.
Rarer species have increased stats.

enemies.name: Vanillawing
enemies.flavour_text: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.

abilities.text: Exotic Beast, Aerial
Tiles it passes through become seeded. Enemies on seeded tiles have increased ASPD.
Seeds nearby tiles and deals a percentage of Arts damage to all nearby allied units whenever a certain amount of HP is lost. Additionally, temporarily reduces Physical and Arts damage taken.
Stops attacking and using skills when HP drops below a certain threshold, instead flying towards the objective. Upon reaching the objective, disappears and moves to another stage.

[Rampant Growth] Periodically selects several Operators (prioritizing those on seeded tiles), dealing a percentage of ATK as Arts splash damage. Defeated targets have significantly longer Redeployment Time.

[Seed of Life] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 6: Enemies on seeded tiles self-destruct when defeated, dealing a percentage of their ATK as Arts damage to nearby allied units and stunning them for several seconds.

enemies.name: Vanillawing
enemies.flavour_text: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.

abilities.text: Aerial, helps your side when on the field; does not attack building materials.
Tiles it passes through become seeded. Allies on seeded tiles have increased ASPD, and deal increased damage to <Monoliths>, <Strange Ore Veins>, and mechanical enemies.
[Rampant Growth] Plants flowers on several allies, reducing their Redeployment Time after their next retreat.
Rarer species have increased stats and enhanced [Rampant Growth] Redeployment Time reduction.

enemies.name: Quicksand Beast
enemies.flavour_text: 'The ground's shaking! It's quaking! It's...' Before the observer can finish, the Quicksand Beast has already closed the distance. Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds. Within seconds, it burrows deep beneath the rock layers, leaving only dusty faces.

abilities.text: Exotic Beast, unblockable.
Movement speed gradually increases while moving (up to a max). Upon colliding with allied units, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK and stuns them for several seconds.
Periodically stops moving and gains a Barrier equal to a percentage of max HP (does not stack).
Burrows underground when HP drops below a certain threshold, gaining increased DEF and RES. After some time, disappears and moves to another stage.
[Earth Spike] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 4: Collision damage has a greater area and reduces targets' ATK.
[Deep Dive] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 6: When Movement Speed is at max, tiles it passes through are no longer deployable.

enemies.name: Quicksand Beast
enemies.flavour_text: 'The ground's shaking! It's quaking! It's...' Before the observer can finish, the Quicksand Beast has already closed the distance. Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds. Within seconds, it burrows deep beneath the rock layers, leaving only dusty faces.

abilities.text: Helps your side when on the field; unblockable.
Movement speed gradually increases while moving (up to a max). Upon colliding with enemies, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK and stuns them for several seconds.
Can pick up Building Materials that it passes by (no limit).
[Earth Spike] Choose an allied Operator within range. Continuously stirs up mud and sand to grant a strong Barrier that gradually decays.
Rarer species have increased stats and enhanced [Earth Spike] Barrier.
